createPayload.body: Read docs/openclinxr/humanoid-motion-delegation-2026-09-14/handoff.md and this card JSON before editing. The live card is authoritative. Preserve all nine laws in the handoff. This is an instrument card. Record one stopEnum verdict. instruments_agree releases SC-07 and forbids A1b; browser_submerged holds SC-07 and authorises owner creation of A1b; capture_null holds SC-07 and requires instrument repair.
